title: LUCI: burning at lunar gravity
note: Partial-gravity flight result from a centrifuge on the ISS (launched 2025-02-04). Published in NTRS, not in PSI.
points: Rotation 11 RPM at 1.22 m radius gives about 0.165 g (calculated from the source values, not stated).
Samples: SIBAL cotton-fiberglass fabric (5 × 30 cm) and PMMA rod (4 mm diameter), burned in air at normal pressure.
SIBAL flame about 3.2 cm wide and 1.5 cm long, semi-steady.
The 1-g SIBAL flame went out about 45 s earlier than the partial-g one.
PMMA partial-g spread about 6 cm before going out.
notReported: flame temperatures, pressures, flow velocities, a numeric O₂ extinction limit
